new.problem: 'Our car is in the ____' with options garage / office / shop: 'Our car is in the shop' is natural English (car at the repair shop), so two options are correct.
new.fix: Use a stem only garage fits (e.g. 'We park our car in the ____ at night.') or replace 'shop' with 'school'.

new.problem: Exact scoring ignores only final punctuation; correct answers with no comma before 'please' ('Can I have the key please?') or 'May I have ...' (accepted in slot 1) are marked wrong.
new.fix: Ignore commas in the normalisation (or add no-comma variants) and add 'May I have ..., please?' variants.

new.check: answer word shown elsewhere in the same form
new.problem: The slot 3-4 options and the slot 7-8 prompts show 'Can I have ... please' and 'I would like ... please', which give away the slot 1 key (Can) and slot 2 key (would) in every form.
new.fix: Present slots 1-2 before slots 3-8 on separate screens, or change slots 1-2 to a target the later items do not show.

new.problem: 'watchs/washs/teachs' keep agreement (the -s is present); the error is the -es spelling rule, not -s omission, and is not an Arabic-L1 transfer error, so agreement_3s (and its L1 rationale) does not fit.
new.fix: Tag as a spelling error (or note agreement_3s covers the -s/-es form rule in PART 2), or use a planted error that omits -s/-es.

new.check: vocabulary above the outcome's CEFR level
new.problem: 'neighbour' is EVP A2, but the item is labelled vocabLevel A1 (K16: all A1 words).
new.fix: Use 'a friend of your family' or 'your uncle' instead of 'a neighbour'; update acceptedAnswers.
